title: qH-preserving cubic storage reconstruction
question: Can curvature inferred only from the existing Wb/Wt/H state improve the gradient-dominant internal flux qi while preserving the already-supported terminal qH closure exactly?

candidate.name: QH_PRESERVING_CUBIC_STORAGE_PROFILE
candidate.coordinate: x=H-z upward from water table; x=0 at water table and x=L=H-anchor at the fixed anchor
candidate.terminal_slope_authority: a is fixed exactly to the B7/B9 terminal-storage linear slope a_t(Wt,d). Therefore qH=Ks*(1-a) is identical to TERMINAL_SIDE_LINEAR at every endpoint.

solver.method: deterministic scipy least_squares on (u,v), no response fit and no clipping
frozen_starts: v=0 and u=(b_bulk-a)*L/(2d), which matches the existing B9 bulk-side slope at the interface in a quadratic seed
u=(a-b_bulk)*L/d and v=-(a-b_bulk)*L^2/d^2, which preserves the linear terminal interface pressure while matching the B9 bulk-side interface slope in the seed
one half of the preceding cubic seed
solver.uniqueness: All valid roots at a quadrature must agree in u and v within combined absolute/relative 1e-8. Otherwise reconstruction is blocked.

comparison.baseline: B9 TERMINAL_SIDE_LINEAR on identical Reference-projected states
comparison.moving_qi_support: For each width and each of WT_RISE and WT_FALL, cubic qi must have strictly lower RMS and MAE than baseline and no greater sign-mismatch count.
comparison.hold_qi_noninferiority: For each width under WT_HOLD, cubic qi RMS and MAE must be no greater than baseline within 1e-12 and sign-mismatch count no greater.
comparison.qH_rule: Candidate qH must be bit/numerically identical to baseline by construction; qH is not traded for qi improvement.

decisions.QH_PRESERVING_CUBIC_QI_SUPPORTED: All hard gates pass; moving qi improves for both widths/directions; HOLD qi is noninferior for both widths; qH identity holds.
decisions.QH_PRESERVING_CUBIC_MOVING_ONLY: All hard gates pass and moving qi improves for both widths/directions, but HOLD qi noninferiority fails.
decisions.QH_PRESERVING_CUBIC_MIXED: All hard gates pass but moving qi improvement is not uniform across width/direction.
decisions.C4L_RECONSTRUCTION_BLOCKED: Any reconstruction, uniqueness, physical-domain, quadrature, hydrostatic, qH-identity or B8-ledger hard gate fails.
